notes: rs17026651 (GRCh37 chr3:30879358) is NOT in this dataset — both the variant page and the API return null. Use Open Targets Genetics, the GWAS Catalog, or a proxy SNP in high linkage disequilibrium instead.

This PheWeb release contains no serum-biomarker GWAS: LDL, HDL, triglycerides, total cholesterol, HbA1c and BMI do not exist as traits. Dyslipidaemia is captured only through self-reported high cholesterol and lipid-lowering medication, adiposity only through weight, fat mass and waist circumference.
'None of the above' medication categories are the inverse coding of the same question and are merged into the corresponding medication group in table b.
Beta is on the Neale-lab linear-model scale; for binary traits it is not an odds ratio.
